notes: CPI is a card manufacturer and payments-technology provider, not an industrial machinery maker; equipment facets mostly do not apply.

machinery_computer_equipment_category.value: No machinery or computer equipment sold; makes credit, debit and prepaid payment cards plus instant-issuance and payments technology services.

installed_equipment_base.value: No equipment base disclosed; instant-issuance offered as SaaS-enabled in-branch service at bank locations.

aftermarket_sales_mix.value: No equipment aftermarket; revenue from card production, personalization, fulfillment and recurring-style platform services.

equipment_replacement_cycle.value: Not an equipment seller; cards are reissued on a recurring basis, from daily reissues to bulk campaigns.

engineering_customization.value: Customized, branded card design and personalization on a flexible platform; premium metal and co-branded cards for each program.

service_maintenance_requirement.value: No equipment maintenance; provides managed issuance, fulfillment and fraud-detection services with nationwide operations for reliability and redundancy.
